description: The file defines the 'ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Pim\Menu' namespace. It implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and uses a trait 'ModuleScreenHelperTrait'. The primary purpose of the class is to configure menu screens, specifically overriding the current screen to 'viewReportingMethods'.

classes.name: ReportingMethodMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for reporting methods, overriding the current screen to 'viewReportingMethods'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen for reporting methods by calling 'overrideScreen' with 'viewReportingMethods', returns null.
